title: refactor: move Klein GPU backend under operations
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Moves the active Klein worker from image.pollinations.ai/klein-runpod to operations/infrastructure/gpu/klein.
- Updates Vast provisioning, fleet inventory, monitoring references, and the container-build workflow context.
- Preserves the existing GHCR image name to avoid changing the registry contract.
- Changes no model behavior, routing, credentials, pricing, or live Vast instances.

Operational note:
- Existing Klein workers keep running their currently checked-out files.
- Do not pull this commit into an existing worker checkout by itself: /root/run-klein.sh points at the old path.
- On a future reprovision or intentional worker update, run setup-vast.sh from the new path so it rewrites the restart command before relying on the new checkout.

Validation:
- operations deployment-detection tests
- shell syntax and Python compilation checks
- container context file checks
- stale-path scan
- git diff --check

Stacked on #13242.

gist.headline: Klein changes greenhouse
gist.blurb: The Klein GPU worker packed its pots and moved into the operations garden. Same GHCR image, same model behavior, tidier soil around the fleet tools.
gist.summary: Moved the active Klein GPU worker from image.pollinations.ai/klein-runpod to operations/infrastructure/gpu/klein, updating Vast provisioning, fleet inventory, monitoring references, and the container-build context while preserving the GHCR image name.
gist.impact: Future Klein reprovisions can use setup-vast.sh from the new operations path, while existing workers continue running unchanged until intentionally updated.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful infrastructure gardener relocating a small cozy GPU-server planter labeled Klein from an image-generation shed into an organized operations greenhouse. Include a friendly CRT monitor robot checking a fleet inventory clipboard, with the same glowing container label carried safely between locations to represent the unchanged registry contract.
